ecgfounder_noninferiority_scope: Per-cell, pointwise comparison against a prespecified engineering margin of 0.02; the margin is not a clinically validated equivalence threshold and the 48 intervals are not multiplicity adjusted. Influence-function intervals are asymptotic, including five evaluable tasks with <=10 positives.

ecgfounder_noninferiority_summary.interpretation: 32/48 reconstructed models meet the prespecified 0.02 margin; all 16 U-Net cells fail. This is an outcome count, not a completeness requirement.

inference_scope.patient_cluster_bca: Conditional on each trained seed-42 model; supports paired patient-cluster contrasts across 1,904 patients/2,198 ECGs, not population-level training-seed generalization.
inference_scope.training_variance: Seeds 1337 and 2026 cover base/full/validation-selected configurations only and are reported separately.
inference_scope.ecgfounder_macro_auroc: Computed over the 31/150 fold-10 tasks containing both classes; 119 tasks are explicitly single-class.
